newsitem.title: CROATIA: RMC to invest DM80 mln in Croatian cement plant.
newsitem.headline: RMC to invest DM80 mln in Croatian cement plant.

text.p: British building materials supplier RMC Group Plc plans to invest 80-100 million German marks into Croatian cementworks Dalmacijacement, daily Vecernji List quoted RMC's Friedrich Fercscho as saying.
The aim was to develop production in three plants, one of which was closed, and remove bottlenecks which prevent Dalmacijacement to increase output, the newspaper said.
RCM hopes to expand construction materials business in the region, largely devastated by the 1991-95 former Yugoslav war, which would require opening of new jobs.
Vecernji List said Fercscho was a member of the management board at Dalmacijacement, but no company officials were available to comment on the investment plans.

RMC bought a 51-percent stake in Dalmacijacement, the largest cement producer in Croatia, for 34 million stg in June. Its annual production totals some 2.3 million tonnes. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
